operating_notes.text: NeoBlack Series all-black G12R DCR module launched 27 April 2026 in 600-630 Wp, with 12-year product and 30-year power warranties.
Subsidiary Premier Energies Global Environment approved acquiring a 26% stake in Hexa Energy BH Five for ₹68.70 Cr to meet captive power needs in Naidupeta.
FY26 capex was ₹2,998 Cr against operating cash flow of ₹1,261 Cr, with capital work in progress of ₹2,144 Cr at 31 March 2026.
Q4FY26 cost of materials was 59.9% of revenue against 58.3% in Q4FY25, and EBITDA margin fell 235 bps to 30.26%.
FY26 cell production was 2,268 MW and module production 3,570 MW, with Q4FY26 effective capacity utilisation of 95% for cells and 94% for modules.
Order book at 31 March 2026 was ₹140.1 Bn, 58% cell and 42% module, entirely domestic; Q4 new orders were ₹24,616 Mn against sales of ₹21,751 Mn.
Transcon (51% acquired) had an order book of ₹231.4 Cr with 22% export share and FY26 revenue of ₹423 Cr.
FY27 capex is planned at ₹5,100 crores to be deployed across cells, ingot wafers, batteries and inverters.
Premier Energies operates 11.1 GW of annual solar PV module capacity and targets 10.6 GW of annual cell capacity later in 2026, per its Wood Mackenzie Grade A ranking release.
FY26: PEIPL standalone turnover ₹4,541 Cr, PAT ₹441 Cr, net worth ₹775 Cr; PEGEPL turnover ₹2,736 Cr, PAT ₹303 Cr, net worth ₹1,788 Cr.
FY26 intra-group flows: PEIPL bought ₹897 Cr from and sold ₹1,170 Cr to PEGEPL; bought ₹728 Cr from and sold ₹947 Cr to PEPPL.
Company's bank borrowing rate range was 7.50% to 10% per annum as on 31 March 2026.
Operational cell plants in Telangana delivered record capacity utilisation of 92% in Q1FY27.
DCR order book is sold out, with sales now being booked for FY28; non-DCR module business is not profitable.
BESS plan of 12 GW with 6 GW Phase 1 has land acquired and construction started; technology partner to be finalised in two to three months.

timeline.summary: On 27 April 2026, Premier Energies launched the NeoBlack Series, an all-black G12R DCR solar module of 600-630 Wp, at RenewX Chennai.
Premier Energies Limited’s Board of Directors, led by **Sreenivasa Ravella**, declared a 2nd interim dividend of ₹0.75 per equity share (75% of face value) on May 4, 2026, payable by June 2, 2026.
On 4 May 2026, Premier Energies announced its subsidiary approved acquiring a 26% stake in Hexa Energy BH Five for ₹68.70 Cr.
On 11 May 2026, Premier Energies announced the amicable termination of its proposed joint acquisition of Ksolare Energy with Syrma SGS.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,230.3 Cr (+37.6% YoY), net profit ₹456.84 Cr (+64.4% YoY).

On 15 May 2026, Premier Energies' Q4/FY26 investor presentation reported FY26 revenue of ₹8,026 Cr (+20.7%), EBITDA of ₹2,579 Cr (32.1% margin) and PAT of ₹1,510 Cr (+61.1%), with the 7 GW Naidupeta cell plant due 4.8 GW by June 2026 and an order book of ₹140.1 Bn.
Chiranjeev Singh Saluja, Managing Director, shared the audio recording of the Analyst Call/Investor Presentation on May 15, 2026, discussing Q4 and FY2026 audited results via the company website.
On May 15, 2026, Premier Energies hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call, reporting FY26 revenue of ₹8,026 Cr and an order book of ₹14,010 Cr.
Surenderpal Singh Saluja, as Promoter and Promoter Group, declared no encumbrance of shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
On 4 June 2026, Premier Energies said Wood Mackenzie's 2026 Global Solar PV Module Manufacturer Ranking placed it among the Top 25 global and Top 3 Indian Grade A module manufacturers.

On 6 June 2026, Premier Energies sent a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for up to ₹7,689 Cr of FY27 related-party transactions among itself, PEIPL, PEGEPL and PEPPL, including a ₹750 Cr loan from PEIPL.

On 13 August 2026, Premier Energies filed the transcript of its 7 August 2026 Q1FY27 earnings call, where management reported 34% YoY revenue growth to ₹2,508 Cr, a ₹15,000 Cr order book and the 7 GW TOPCon cell line in advanced commissioning.

Premier Battery Technologies Private Limited, RCT Nexor Energy Private Limited, and Premier Energies Storage Solutions Private Limited executed a Share Allotment cum Shareholders Agreement on 15 October 2026.
